title: Reconstruction of finite quasi-bialgebras from quasi-fiber functors up to twisting
difficulty_reason: After ordinary abelian and monoidal-fiber reconstruction, the remaining work handles a non-coherent normalized J: construct the transported associator Φ via (5.20), turn the categorical pentagon/triangle and J into (5.21)–(5.24), use exactly these identities to reconstruct Rep(H), then identify changes of J with the displayed simultaneous twists of coproduct and associator and match both quotient classifications. Count this complete new bidirectional coherence-and-twist chain as one H2, including 5.12.4. The source provides the displayed construction and proof sketches at printed granularity.
